## What's new

- A shader for every console: a CRT look for the NES, SNES, Genesis, Master System and TurboGrafx-16, and an LCD look for the Game Gear and Neo Geo Pockets, beside PT SkyWalker541 for the Game Boys. Each has its settings on its own page, applied at once in the in-game menu.

---

ChaOS 0.7.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.7.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.7.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
